figures.before: What Commercial Construction Project Types Exist in Jacksonville
figures.alt: First-generation commercial shell under construction with open structure, concrete floor, service rough-ins, and future tenant space
figures.caption: The right project approach begins with the real operating need. A shell, fit-out, renovation, medical space, industrial building, restaurant, or mixed-use project each brings a different structure, service, code, schedule, and turnover path.

figures.before: The Pro Forma: How Construction Costs, Soft Costs, and Contingency Fit Into Your Model
figures.alt: Construction planning table with drawings, measuring tools, a blank clipboard, and coordination materials
figures.caption: A credible early model distinguishes hard construction work from design, permitting, testing, financing, owner costs, allowances, contingency, and the decisions that have not yet been resolved.

figures.before: Site Acquisition and Due Diligence in Jacksonville
figures.alt: Commercial site layout with driveway access, building approach, vehicle turning area, utility zone, and landscaped edge
figures.caption: Due diligence needs to test access and the usable site area before the deal is committed. Circulation, drainage, utilities, setbacks, grade, permitting, and the building’s operational requirements have to fit together.
